caseName: Akron, Canton & Youngstown Ry. Co. v. United States
caseNameFull: Akron, Canton & Youngstown Ry. Co. v. United States
attorneys: Mr. Leo P. Day, with whom Mr. Anthony P. Donadío was on the brief, for appellants., Mr. J. Stanley Payne,' with whom Solicitor General Thacker, Assistant to the Attorney General O’Brian, and Messrs. Daniel W. Knowlton and E. M. Reidy were on the brief, for the United States et al.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The Court is of the opinion that the Interstate Commerce Commission acted within its authority and that its order is supported by substantial evidence. The decree is affirmed. Western Chemical Co. v. United States, 271 U. S. 268, 271; Chicago, R. I. & P. Ry. Co. v. United States, 274 U. S. 29, 33, 34; Alabama v. United States, 283 U. S. 776, 779.
